name: Swarming Strike
body:
You have much more proficiency manipulating your swarm body, and this proficiency grants you a swarm attack.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, mannequin

Benefit(s): As a full round action, the mannequin can make a single swarm attack against all adjacent creatures. The damage from a mannequin’s swarm attack is treated as though it were a swarm with an HD equal to the mannequin’s class level -2. (As indicated on Table: Swarm Damage by Size in the Pathfinder Core Rulebook).
